title: potentilla hirta subsp. adriatica
intro: Potentilla hirta subsp. adriatica, commonly known as Dalmatian cinquefoil, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is primarily known for its medicinal properties, particularly its use in treating various health conditions due to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antiviral, and anti-tumor activities. The health benefits of Potentilla hirta subsp. adriatica include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exerting antioxidant effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various diseases.
